Privacy

Privacy policy

Altiora is a free website that helps students compare university course entry requirements with their own subjects and grades. This page explains, in plain English, what happens to your information when you use it.

Last updated 14 November 2026

Who runs Altiora

Altiora is run by Adam Arab, in Dubai, UAE. If you have a question about this policy or your information, email support@usealtiora.com.

The short version

  • There are no accounts. You never give us a name, email address or password to use Altiora.
  • Altiora does not use cookies.
  • What you enter in the app (your subjects, grades, shortlist and notes) is saved only in your own browser. It is not sent to us, and we can’t see it.
  • We count visits with Cloudflare Web Analytics, which doesn’t use cookies and doesn’t receive anything you enter in the app.
  • The site’s fonts come from Google Fonts, so Google receives your IP address when a page loads.

What the app saves, and where

When you use the app, it saves your progress in your browser’s local storage: a small storage area on your own device that belongs to this website. It keeps one entry, called altiora_state_v1, which holds:

  • your qualification system, year group and the stage you’re at;
  • your subjects and predicted grades;
  • your interests and the fields you’ve kept;
  • the courses on your shortlist;
  • your story bank entries and application checklist ticks;
  • your personal statement drafts;
  • the date and time of your first and most recent visit.

This stays in the browser on the device you used. It is not sent to us or to anyone else. If you use a different device or browser, your information won’t be there unless you move it with a backup file (see below).

To check that saving works, the app writes a test value and deletes it straight away. If your browser blocks storage, the app still works but saves nothing.

If you open the app from the “Start from your strengths and interests” link, it also keeps one temporary marker in session storage that tells it to open that view. Session storage lasts only for that browser tab.

The home page, the field guides and the course and university pages save nothing.

Backups and downloads

“Back up my data” saves a file to your device, and “Restore from backup” reads a file you choose from your device. Downloading your shortlist as a spreadsheet also creates the file on your device. None of these files are uploaded anywhere.

How to delete your information

Because everything is stored in your browser, you delete it there. In your browser’s settings, clear the site data for usealtiora.com (browsers call this “site data”, “website data” or “cookies and site data”). This removes everything the app saved. If you made a backup file, delete that file too.

Cookies and storage

Altiora does not use any cookies, and neither do the services it loads (Google Fonts and Cloudflare Web Analytics). We loaded every type of page in a fresh browser and no cookies were created. That is why there is no cookie banner.

The only browser storage the site uses is the local storage and session storage described above. Only the app uses it, only to make the app work, and it is never sent anywhere.

Visit counting: Cloudflare Web Analytics

To see how many people visit and which pages are used, Altiora uses Cloudflare Web Analytics. It does not use cookies or browser storage. When a page loads, a small script from Cloudflare sends Cloudflare:

  • the address of the page you’re on, without anything after a “?” in the address;
  • the address of the page that linked you there, if there was one;
  • your browser type and version;
  • technical measurements of how quickly the page loaded;
  • like any request over the internet, your IP address.

It does not receive your subjects, grades, shortlist or anything else you enter in the app. Cloudflare handles this information under its own privacy policy.

Fonts: Google Fonts

The site’s typefaces are loaded from Google Fonts. To send them, Google’s servers receive your IP address, your browser type and the address of this website (usealtiora.com, not the page you’re on). No cookies are involved. Google handles this information under its own privacy policy.

Hosting: GitHub Pages

The website is hosted on GitHub Pages, run by GitHub. Like any web host, GitHub’s servers receive your IP address and the details of each request your browser makes when a page loads, such as which file was requested and your browser type, and GitHub may keep records of these requests. GitHub handles this information under its own privacy statement.

Emailing us

There is no contact form. If you email support@usealtiora.com, your message reaches us as an ordinary email, with your email address and whatever you write. We use it only to reply to you and to deal with what you’ve told us. Please don’t include personal information we don’t need.

Who Altiora is for

Altiora is intended for students aged 14 and over. It does not collect personal information through forms: there are no accounts, no sign-up and no contact form, and anything you write in the app is saved only in your browser.

Links to other websites

The app and the course pages link to universities’ own websites. When you follow one of those links you leave Altiora, and that website’s own privacy policy applies.

Changes to this policy

If the way the site handles information changes, we will update this page and the date at the top.
